clips.title: The story
paras: At Xavian, ancient waters hold arcane power sought by Horde mages in Orgrimmar. They seek it to unravel the latent magic preserved in Ashenvale's oldest sacred sites.

Xavian was a fabled ancient elven city, and its old knowledge remains known among the learned. Even in ruin, its waters are said to hold great magical power. Deino, an arcane instructor in Orgrimmar, sends rising mages deep into Ashenvale to draw fresh water from the pool beneath Xavian's tallest waterfall. They must cross dangerous ground, for corrupt satyrs now guard the ruins fiercely and oppose spellcasters who meddle there.
